intro.heading: Holiday Cruises Around New York Harbor
paragraphs: For unforgettable holiday celebrations, make Skyline Cruises your destination.

You'll make unforgettable memories and cherish the fabulous photos you'll take with the Statue of Liberty and other world-famous New York landmarks in the background. The Skyline Princess offers unparalleled access to its three decks, including our all-weather rooftop deck with a dance floor and dedicated DJ space, if you hire one. Event/party hosts can hire a caterer to provide food and drinks and can bring in their own staff to accommodate guest needs during private events. Alcohol is allowed on a limited basis. We can provide a list of recommended vendors or you can choose your own. We provide the space; you bring the party!

Why watch fireworks on TV when you can see spectacular 4th of July and New Year's Eve fireworks from the skylight deck of the Skyline Princess? The climate-controlled cabin and enclosed all-weather rooftop deck provide spectacular views of the celebrations. Bring that special someone or a group of special someones. Our popular cruises are sure to make these holidays even more fun.

For Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, and Father's Day, Skyline offers special holiday cruises that will make it a magical day for your loved ones. Lovely brunch cruises are a great way to let Mom and Dad know how special they are to the family. A dinner cruise on Valentine's Day is a romantic and unique way to say I love you to that special person in your life. The Skyline Princess is always a popular choice for company holiday celebrations as well.
